# Postman Mock Server Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Postman

## Overview

Creates Postman mock servers for API simulation with proper response matching, dynamic responses, and development workflow integration

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [postman-mock-server-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
postman-mock-server-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@postman-mock-server-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Create mock servers from collections
- Configure response matching rules
- Implement dynamic mock responses
- Share mocks across team workspace

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Mock Servers**: Postman mock server configuration
- **Response Matching**: Request matching and response selection
- **Development Workflow**: Mock integration in development
